tasks.do: Six tools in build/tools/tiers/, each a thin wrapper over the tools we have (no check rewritten), each with --dry-run (what will run, roughly how long), each writing its result to build/reports/tiers/<tier>-<commit>.json and a short .md: check-push (tier 0: checks.mjs), check-prototype (tier 1: --lab <page>: labcheck at the four sizes, page errors, a first-play film), check-change (tier 2: games and rows from the git diff against the merge base by default, or --games/--rows/--base; the robot play-through at the levels touched at 740x320 and 930x430 with that game's contract rules; each named row's probe red then green; before/after pictures made by script from the base commit and the candidate; a first-play film of L1 as a new player for the orchestrator to look at), check-sprint (tier 3: since the last publish; changed games L1-L4 at the four sizes, all rules, end reached, 0 page errors; every other game end reached at one size; chai's frozen run; the judge batches for Fable (probe sheets, beside chai for games on their new art); first-minute films; ONE fix list grouped by game), check-publish (tier 3b: the failures plus every changed game at one size to its end, checks.mjs --browser, the known-fails list written, then publish.mjs --go), check-live (tier 4: each changed game opened on the live site at 740x320, page errors and a strip; on a failure it prints the exact command to put main back to the last good publish). What each tier runs (sizes, levels, which checks) lives in one file, build/tools/tiers/tiers.json.
